participation.context: Whispered it through, and ended it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.quote: He knew it before I did.

story.body: You put the bar, the boy's cry, and the gallows into a whisper, and you did not go to the window to test them. You set the two houses in a street, among serving-men, with heat and one word too many. You did not open Brooke. You stopped yourself.

relations.quote: He knew it before I did.

topics: Tower Hill heard and not seen
the two houses not yet a page

title: Told himself to remember the dark for the serving-men
